content: आचमनम् .²1 Rinsing the mouth, sipping water before religious ceremonies, before and after meals <ab>&c.</ab> from the palm of the hand; दद्यादाचमनं ततः <ls>Y. 1. 243</ls>, <ls n="Y. 1.">195</ls> (part of the water sipped being usually allowed to drop down). .²2 The water used for rinsing the mouth. .²3 Gargling the throat. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant Andropogon muricatum (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>वाळा</ns>). .²5 Water for rinsing the vulva (Āyurveda).
